name: blast-radius-calibration
description: Labeled change descriptions for calibrating judge-blast-radius. Each row describes a change/fix/defect with its dependency facts; expectedOutput is the human-scoped radius (isolated/local/wide). Traps included in every direction: scary-area-but-no-op changes (isolated), huge diffs confined to one test fixture (isolated), one-liners in a base class or shared client lib (local/wide), and config-sounding changes to flag evaluation that touch every surface (wide). Run via the blast-radius-calibration eval (exact scorer).

rows.input: Fixed a typo in the empty-state copy of the billing settings screen. The string is a literal inside that one component; it does not come from a shared strings file.
Renamed a local variable inside a private helper in report-worker. The helper is not exported and has no callers outside the file.
A change inside the auth module — but it only rewrites a doc comment and fixes indentation. The compiled output is byte-identical; CI's build-diff check confirms no behavioral change.
Adjusted padding in the dashboard summary card's own stylesheet. The card is used on exactly one screen; the stylesheet is not imported anywhere else.
Added a new unit test for the slug generator. No production code was touched.
A 400-line diff — but every line is inside one regenerated mock fixture consumed by a single test file. No production code or shared fixture changed.

Reworded the human-readable message text in one cron job's log line. Alerting matches on the structured event field, which is unchanged; a search of the alert rules confirms nothing matches the message text.
Changed the default sort constant used by the archived-projects page. A repo-wide search shows exactly one import: that page.
Refactored the date-formatting util imported by the invoices list and the invoice detail page — two importers, both inside the billing area.
Tightened password validation in the shared password-field component. It is used by the signup form and the password-reset form; nothing else imports it.
A one-line change — but in the base widget class extended by the three chart widgets on the analytics dashboard. All three inherit the changed behavior.
Modified the pagination component used by the four admin tables. It is admin-area only; the customer-facing tables use a different component.
Bumped the charting library by a minor version. Charts render on three analytics screens; no other surface uses the library.
Changed the retry policy of the email-sending worker. It affects the transactional emails that queue feeds — welcome and receipt — and no other queues or jobs.
A change under the api/ directory — but to an internal admin-only endpoint with exactly two consumers, both admin pages, confirmed via the route's access log.
Changed a CSS token in the settings theme file. The five settings sub-pages import it; a repo-wide search confirms no importers outside settings.
Changed the JSON shape of the shared API error envelope that every endpoint returns. All clients parse this envelope.
A database migration changes the users table primary key from int to UUID. Every service joins against users.
A one-line change to the default timeout in the shared HTTP client library — the client every service uses for internal calls.
The auth middleware now requires an X-Client-Version header. Every authenticated route passes through this middleware.
Upgraded the UI framework by a major version across the entire app; the render path of every screen is affected.
Renamed the order.completed event on the message bus. Producers in this repo were updated, but consumers in other services subscribe by event name.
Changed the rule-evaluation order in the feature-flag service. Flags gate behavior on every surface, so evaluation-order changes can flip which variant any user sees anywhere.
Rewrote the global state store's hydration logic that runs on every page load before any screen renders.
